media.caption: Chat log with channel filters, composer, and whisper auto-reply.

added: Korean (한국어) language support — pick 한국어 under Settings → Themes → Language (needs Stellar 2.21.0).
changed: The Chat Tools window title now follows your language.

ja.description: チャットキャプチャ + 快適機能のチャットツール。

changed: ChatToolsウィンドウのタイトルが選択した言語に従うようになりました。

captions: Log chat dengan filter channel, composer, dan balas otomatis bisikan.

fil.description: Pagkuha ng chat + mga chat tool na quality-of-life.

changed: Ang pamagat ng ChatTools window ay sumusunod na ngayon sa iyong wika.
